title: Public Subnet Instance Unreachable (Missing Public IP)
symptom: Instance launched in public subnet with IGW route cannot be reached from internet.
initial_observations: Instance has private IP (10.0.1.50) but no Public IPv4 address.

possible_causes.cause: Auto-assign public IPv4 address was disabled on subnet and instance launch
possible_causes.evidence_needed: describe-instances shows PublicIpAddress is null or missing.
possible_causes.remediation: Allocate and associate an Elastic IP (EIP) to the instance's network interface.

investigation_steps.title: Inspect Instance Public IP Assignment
investigation_steps.explanation: Check if a public IP exists on the primary network interface.

verification: Public IP assigned and reachable via ping or SSH.
